summary: T001: Makefile.toml — remove verify-tech-stack{,-local} tasks + drop them from ci-local / ci-container dependencies (IN-01, AC-01).
T002: apps/cli + apps/cli-driver — remove VerifyCommand::TechStack, VerifyInput::TechStack, related handle/execute/telemetry arms, and TechStack tests (IN-01, AC-02, AC-03).

T003: libs/usecase + libs/infrastructure + libs/domain — remove verify_tech_stack trait methods + impls, delete tech_stack.rs, drop the tech-stack.md cross-reference from architecture_rules.rs verify_member_references, and replace the retired literal in signal.rs test cases (IN-01, AC-03).
T004: knowledge/adr/ — author grandfathered aggregate ADR from the retired track decision docs (IN-03, CN-03, AC-05).
T005: README.md — integrate track/product.md reader-facing content into the existing README structure (IN-04, CN-06, AC-14).
T006: track/tech-stack.md + track/product.md + track/product-guidelines.md deletion + .harness/config/template-boundary.json entries removal, run after T004/T005 (IN-02, IN-08, AC-04, AC-09).
T007: CLAUDE.md — remove SoT-map row and Hard-invariants TODO-marker bullet (IN-05, AC-06).
T008: .claude/rules/{01,07,08,09,10}-*.md — remove retirement references from 5 orchestrator rule files (IN-06, AC-07).

T009: .harness/workflows/track/{init,plan}.md + .claude/commands/{track/catchup,track/setup,architecture-customizer}.md + .claude/skills/architecture-customizer/SKILL.md — remove retirement references from workflow, command, and skill docs (IN-07, CN-01, AC-08).

T010: knowledge/conventions/{README,hexagonal-architecture,testing,nightly-dev-tool,source-attribution}.md — remove retirement references, replace Blue source examples in source-attribution.md (IN-10, AC-10).

T011: apps/cli/tests/retention_gate.rs (or equivalent) + `bin/sotp track views sync` + `cargo make ci` — add terminal retention and validation task (IN-09, CN-04, CN-05, CN-07, AC-11, AC-12, AC-13, OS-01, OS-06).

Execution ordering rationale: T001 (Makefile) → T002 (cli + cli_driver) → T003 (usecase + infra + collateral) keeps each intermediate commit buildable; T004 (aggregate ADR) and T005 (README absorption) run before T006 (physical file deletion) so upstream content is still source-readable during promotion; T007–T010 precede the terminal T011 validation.

Goal traceability (task-coverage.json schema has no `goal` section by design — see `libs/infrastructure/src/verify/plan_artifact_refs/task_coverage.rs` §5c; goal-to-task mapping is authored here in impl-plan.json plan.summary): GO-01 (TODO-marker state eradication) → T001/T002/T003/T007/T008/T009/T011 (T011 retention gate prevents reintroduction of the verify-tech-stack / VerifyCommand::TechStack / verify_tech_stack identifiers); GO-02 (ADR consolidation of tech-stack / product decisions) → T004/T005/T006; GO-03 (live surface sweep + machine-verified retention) → T001/T002/T003/T006/T007/T008/T009/T010/T011.
